trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no extra task: finish the roadmap, then claim it. Keep this guide open from hour one so nothing missable slips past.

steps.t: Earn all 54 other trophies in this guide, in roadmap order.
Check the tracker: 55/55 earned, 1,350/1,350 PSN points.
The platinum unlocks automatically on the 54th trophy; no final mission is needed.
If it does not pop, reload the save and re-check the in-game trophy list.
Open the trophy list in-game to see all 54 requirements at a glance.
Work the roadmap stages in order; each stage lists its trophies.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story mission early in Chapter 1. Lucia and Jason go fishing off the Leonida coast; finish the mission and the trophy pops at the debrief.

steps.t: Play the story until the Gone Fishing mission unlocks in Chapter 1.
Follow the on-screen prompts: cast, wait for the bite, reel in steadily.
Do not let the line snap: reel only while the fish is not pulling hard.
Finish the mission and the trophy pops at the end-of-mission screen.
If it fails, retry from the last checkpoint; progress is kept.
Use the fishing guide for the reel timing if the line keeps snapping.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete every story mission in Chapter 1. There is no way to miss it: just play the story to the chapter card.

steps.t: Play all Chapter 1 story missions in order (see the walkthrough).
Side activities are optional here; the chapter ends on the story beat.
The final Chapter 1 mission is a story set-piece; finish it.
The trophy pops when the Chapter 2 title card appears.
Missable check: meditate at the Chapter 1 balcony spot before leaving (see Positive Mental Attitude).
Check the walkthrough if a Chapter 1 mission is unclear.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete every story mission in Chapter 2. The chapter is longer than Chapter 1 and introduces the first big heist planning beats.

steps.t: Play all Chapter 2 story missions in order.
Use the walkthrough for the heist-prep missions; they gate the chapter end.
Keep a Chapter 2 save before the final mission in case a missable is missed.
Finish the last Chapter 2 mission to trigger the chapter card.
The trophy pops with the Chapter 3 title card.
Chapter 2 introduces heist planning; follow the prep missions in order.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete every story mission in Chapter 3. This is the Vice City homecoming chapter; the city opens up fully here.

steps.t: Play all Chapter 3 story missions in order.
New districts unlock as the chapter progresses; explore between missions.
The chapter's finale is a multi-part story mission; complete all parts.
The trophy pops when the Chapter 4 title card appears.
Good time to bank collectibles: card sets and flamingos are now reachable.
Vice City opens fully in Chapter 3; grab the map collectibles as you go.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete every story mission in Chapter 4. The story escalates toward the finale; several missable moments live in this chapter.

steps.t: Play all Chapter 4 story missions in order.
Before the finale, clear any at-risk missables (see the Missables tab).
Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 4 as insurance.
Finish the last Chapter 4 mission to trigger the finale.
The trophy pops with the finale title card.
Chapter 4's finale is long; stock up on armor and ammo first.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. The ending you pick matters for one thing only: read the Endings guide before the final choice so you do not lock yourself out of post-game cleanup.

steps.t: Finish Chapter 4 to unlock the final mission.
Before starting it, read the Endings guide: the final choice is explained there.
Play the final mission to its end; it is a long multi-stage mission.
Watch the ending cutscene through to the credits.
The trophy pops at the end-of-mission screen.
After the credits, free roam continues: cleanup collectibles and 100% from here.
Finish any at-risk missables before starting the final mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story mission in Chapter 1. A morning run that turns into a chase; keep the car in one piece and stay with your partner.

steps.t: Unlock Breakfast Run in Chapter 1 story progression.
Drive the route; the mission is a timed drive with a chase section.
Stay close to your partner's car during the chase.
Avoid heavy damage: a wrecked car can fail the mission.
Finish the run to pop the trophy at the debrief.
Watch tier: the mission is only available in Chapter 1; finish it before the chapter ends.
The chase section is timed; keep your speed up on the straights.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story heist in Chapter 3. A planned bank job: follow the setup, then execute the heist without tripping the alarm early.

steps.t: Unlock The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
Complete the setup missions first; they are required, not optional.
During the heist, follow the marked route and the crew's calls.
Keep the take: do not drop the bags during the escape.
Reach the getaway point to finish the heist.
The trophy pops at the end-of-mission screen.
The alarm trips if you are spotted early; move fast once inside.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story mission in Chapter 1. A family errand that goes sideways; protect the kid and finish the job.

steps.t: Unlock Child's Play in Chapter 1 story progression.
Follow the mission markers through the neighborhood sequence.
Keep the child safe during the confrontation: stay in cover.
Finish the escort section without losing the tail.
Complete the mission to pop the trophy.
Watch tier: only available in Chapter 1; do it before the chapter ends.
The escort section is slow; keep the kid close and in cover.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story mission in Chapter 3. A headline gig that ends in a fall; play it straight and the trophy is yours.

steps.t: Unlock Headliners in Chapter 3 story progression.
Play the setup: meet the contact and take the job.
The gig turns into a fight; use cover and Combat Focus.
Escape the venue through the marked exit.
Finish the mission to pop the trophy.
No special requirements: any approach that finishes the mission counts.
The fight at the venue is close-quarters; bring a shotgun.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story mission in Chapter 3 at the airport. Take down the target at VCIA without letting the plane leave.

steps.t: Unlock VCIA Takedown in Chapter 3.
Infiltrate the airport grounds following the mission markers.
Take down the target's guards quietly if possible; loud works too.
Stop the plane before it taxis: block the runway or disable it.
Finish the takedown and escape the airport.
The trophy pops at the end-of-mission screen.
Airport security is heavy; use the service entrance marked on the map.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story mission in Chapter 4. A storm operation in the north of Leonida; bring heavy weapons and warm up the engine.

steps.t: Unlock Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 4.
Stock up on armor and ammo before starting.
Fight through the compound in the snow; visibility is low, use the minimap.
Complete each objective in order; the storm does not lift early.
Extract at the marked point to finish.
The trophy pops at the end-of-mission screen.
The snowstorm limits visibility; follow the objective markers, not the road.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist has 35 lines: story, strangers, activities, collectibles and more. Work it after the finale with the checklist open.

steps.t: Finish the story first; completion is counted from the in-game checklist.
Open the 100% checklist and work the 35 lines one by one.
Story missions and stranger strands are the biggest lines; clear them early.
Collectibles (cards, flamingos, meditations) count toward the total.
Activities (races, stunts, ranges) each add lines; use the activities guide.
The in-game stats page shows your percentage; check it often.
At 100%, the trophy pops immediately.
If stuck at 99%, re-check the checklist: one line is usually a missed activity.
All 35 lines are listed with sources in the Sources tab.

dispute.a: Some guides list 34 completion lines.
dispute.b: Others list 35 lines, including the final stranger strand.
dispute.call: Our call: 35 lines, per the OutputLag 100% checklist, which names all 35.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts: jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime all count. Farm them on the highway loop with a fast car.

steps.t: Any stunt counts: jumps, drifts, near-misses, wheelies, airtime.
The highway loop outside Vice City is the fastest farm: long straights, ramps, traffic.
Use a fast car with good handling; the counter ticks per stunt event.
Chain stunts without crashing to keep the counter climbing.
Check progress in the stats page under Stunts.
At 250, the trophy pops mid-drive.
Stunt jumps also count toward the 250; mix jumps into the loop.

dispute.a: Some guides say only stunt jumps count.
dispute.b: Others count every stunt event (drifts, near-misses, airtime).
dispute.call: Our call: every stunt event counts; jumps are just the fastest way to farm.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type once: races, shooting ranges, fishing, bowling, pool, darts, arcade and more. One attempt each is enough.

steps.t: Open the activities list in the map or the activities guide.
Try one race of any type.
Try one shooting range challenge.
Try fishing once (rod from any bait shop).
Try bowling, pool and darts once each.
Play one arcade game to completion.
The trophy pops when the last activity type is tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold medals in every shooting range challenge. Learn each range's target pattern, then run it clean. Use a pistol with a steady aim for the timed rounds.

steps.t: Find a shooting range on the map; there are several across Leonida.
Each range has timed target challenges; gold needs speed and accuracy.
Aim for headshots on static targets; they score highest.
Reload between waves, not during them.
Repeat a challenge until gold; silver does not count.
Clear all ranges to gold for the trophy.
If a range bugs out, leave and re-enter to reset it.

dispute.a: Some guides say 3 ranges hold the challenges.
dispute.b: Others count 5 ranges, including the military range.
dispute.call: Our call: gold every challenge the range menu shows; the counter is per-challenge, not per-range.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location. Drone races are short; learn each course's gates, then fly clean.

steps.t: Find Top Fun drone race markers on the map.
Each location hosts one race; win it to check it off.
Fly through every gate; missing one costs the race.
Use boost on the straights, brake before tight turns.
Losing is fine: retry instantly from the race menu.
Win at every location to pop the trophy.
The map shows un-won locations with a distinct marker.

dispute.a: Some guides list 4 drone race locations.
dispute.b: Others list 6, including the island course.
dispute.call: Our call: win every race the map marks; the trophy counts locations won, not races run.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races: street, off-road, boat and air races all count. Different means 20 distinct race events, not 20 wins of the same one.

steps.t: Find race markers on the map: street, off-road, boat, air.
Each distinct race event counts once when won.
Use the right vehicle class for each race type.
Learn the course: one practice run, then race to win.
Repeating a won race does not add to the count.
Track progress in stats under Races Won.
At 20 different wins, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal fishes the Leonida piers; challenge him, then out-fish him on weight.

steps.t: Get a fishing rod from any bait shop.
Find Cal at the pier fishing spot (see the fishing guide).
Challenge Cal to a fishing challenge from the prompt.
Cast where the fish ripple; reel steadily, not wildly.
Heavier total catch wins; target the bigger ripples.
Beat Cal's weight to win the challenge and pop the trophy.
Losing lets you retry immediately; Cal stays at the pier.

dispute.a: Some guides say any fish beats Cal.
dispute.b: Others say only total weight matters, and small fish lose.
dispute.call: Our call: total weight decides it; fish the big ripples.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any arcade game to its end. Arcades sit in malls and bars across Leonida; pick the shortest cabinet and finish it.

steps.t: Find an arcade cabinet in a mall or bar.
Pick any game; the shortest ones take a few minutes.
Play to the game's end screen; quitting early does not count.
Use the controls guide if the cabinet's controls are unclear.
Beat the final level or reach the high-score screen.
The trophy pops when the game completes.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's mission strand to its final mission. Andy's jobs unlock in Chapter 1; finish every one.

steps.t: Meet Andy in Chapter 1 to start his strand.
Complete each of Andy's missions in order.
His jobs mix driving and light combat; bring a fast car.
The final mission is a longer drive with a chase.
Finish it to pop the trophy.
Andy's strand is separate from the main story; check the map for his marker.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's mission strand to its final mission. Kenton's jobs are boat work; finish every one.

steps.t: Meet Kenton in Chapter 3 to start his strand.
Complete each of Kenton's missions in order.
His jobs are boat-based: practice boat handling early.
The final mission is a boat chase through the canals.
Finish it to pop the trophy.
Kenton's marker stays on the map until the strand is done.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's mission strand to its final mission. Billy's jobs are bike work; finish every one.

steps.t: Meet Billy in Chapter 3 to start his strand.
Complete each of Billy's missions in order.
His jobs are bike-based: use a fast, stable bike.
The final mission is a long bike ride with a pursuit.
Finish it to pop the trophy.
Billy's marker stays on the map until the strand is done.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as '?' markers; each strand is 2–4 missions. Andy, Kenton and Billy count toward the 8.

steps.t: Stranger strands appear as '?' markers on the map.
Andy, Kenton and Billy are three of the eight.
Each strand runs 2–4 missions; finish each to the end.
Five more strangers are scattered across the state.
Use the characters guide to find every stranger's first meeting.
Some strangers only appear after certain story chapters.
Complete any 8 strands to pop the trophy.
Track strands in the in-game log under Strangers.
Extra strands beyond 8 still count toward 100%.

dispute.a: Some guides count 8 strands total in the game.
dispute.b: Others say there are more than 8, and any 8 count.
dispute.call: Our call: any 8 completed strands pop it; there are more than 8 available.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's mission strand to its final mission. Randy's jobs are supply runs; finish every one.

steps.t: Meet Randy in Chapter 1 to start his strand.
Complete each of Randy's missions in order.
His jobs are supply runs: deliver the goods intact.
Damaged goods can fail a run; drive carefully.
The final mission is a long supply run under pressure.
Finish it to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission. Tyrone's jobs are DJ and club work; finish every one.

steps.t: Meet Tyrone in Chapter 3 to start his strand.
Complete each of Tyrone's missions in order.
His jobs mix club scenes and driving; follow the markers.
The final mission is a club set-piece with a getaway.
Finish it to pop the trophy.
Tyrone's marker stays on the map until the strand is done.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.desc: Complete all 18 meditations at the 10 meditation spots.
trophies.guide: Complete all 18 meditations at the 10 meditation spots. Meditate at every spot; some spots hold two meditations. Use the meditation map and go spot by spot.

steps.t: Open the meditation map: 10 spots across Leonida.
Stand at a spot and hold the meditate prompt until the session completes.
Each spot gives 1–2 meditations; the counter shows x/18.
Meditation spots are marked with a lotus icon on the map once found.
The other 9 spots are open all game; use the meditation map.
One spot is the Chapter 1 balcony: meditate there before Chapter 1 ends.
Finish all 18 meditations to pop the trophy.
If a prompt does not appear, step back and re-approach the spot.

dispute.a: Some guides say 10 meditations at 10 spots.
dispute.b: Others say 18 meditations at 10 spots.
dispute.call: Our call: 18 meditations at 10 spots; the tracker counts 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.guide: Get 5 hunting kills. Hunting grounds sit in the rural north; bring a rifle and track the animals quietly.

steps.t: Find a hunting ground in the rural north of the map.
Bring a rifle; a scope helps at distance.
Crouch and approach slowly; animals flee at noise.
Aim for a clean kill; wounded animals run.
Each kill counts; 5 total pops the trophy.
Check progress in stats under Hunting.

dispute.a: Some guides say any 5 animals count.
dispute.b: Others say only big game (deer, boar) counts.
dispute.call: Our call: any 5 hunting kills count; small game included.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.desc: Collect all 50 collectible cards in all 5 sets.
trophies.guide: Collect all 50 cards in 5 sets of 10. Cards hide in shops, bars and houses across Leonida. Use the card map and sweep district by district.

steps.t: Open the card map: 5 sets of 10 cards each.
Cards glow faintly; check shelves, counters and tables.
Sweep one district at a time; the tracker shows per-set counts.
Use the collectible map to plan a district sweep.
Some cards are inside interiors; enter every open building.
Collect all 50 cards to pop the trophy.
If a card is missed, the map marker stays until collected.

dispute.a: Some guides say 50 cards in 5 sets.
dispute.b: Others say 60 cards in 6 sets, counting a hidden set.
dispute.call: Our call: 50 cards, 5 sets; no hidden sixth set exists.

trophies.name: WAiNK
trophies.guide: Complete 4 WAiNK radio jingle challenges. Tune to WAiNK and answer the jingle prompts; four correct answers pop the trophy.

steps.t: Tune any car radio to the WAiNK station.
Jingle challenges play at intervals; listen for the prompt.
Answer the prompt correctly from the on-screen options.
Each correct answer counts; wrong answers can be retried.
Complete 4 jingle challenges to pop the trophy.
If no challenge plays, drive around: they trigger while driving.

trophies.name: My Kingdom
trophies.guide: Buy 4 properties. Properties go on sale as the story progresses; save cash and buy the cheapest four first.

steps.t: Properties appear for sale on the in-game property site.
Save cash: the cheapest four cost under $200k combined.
Buy the first property as soon as it lists.
Each purchase counts; 4 total pops the trophy.
Properties also generate income; check them weekly in-game.
Later properties are pricier; the cheap four are enough.
If a property is not listed, advance the story to unlock it.

dispute.a: Some guides say any 4 properties count.
dispute.b: Others say only income properties count, not safehouses.
dispute.call: Our call: any 4 purchasable properties count, safehouses included.

trophies.name: King Of Vice
trophies.guide: Take over 5 criminal businesses. Businesses become available after story missions; buy in, then run them.

steps.t: Criminal businesses unlock as the story progresses.
Visit a business and buy in from the prompt.
Each takeover counts; 5 total pops the trophy.
Businesses generate income; collect it regularly.
Rival crews may attack a business; defend it to keep it.
If a business is lost, retake it from the same prompt.

dispute.a: Some guides say 5 takeovers are enough.
dispute.b: Others say the business must also be profitable to count.
dispute.call: Our call: the takeover itself counts; profit is not required.

trophies.name: Gimme Shelter
trophies.desc: Evade a 5-star wanted level in a safehouse.
trophies.guide: Evade a 5-star wanted level by hiding in a safehouse. Get the cops to 5 stars, then drive to a safehouse and stay inside until the heat dies.

steps.t: Own at least one safehouse (see My Kingdom).
Raise your wanted level to 5 stars: rob, shoot, cause chaos.
Drive to your safehouse without being busted.
Enter the safehouse and wait inside.
Stay until the wanted level clears completely.
The trophy pops when the heat dies inside the safehouse.
If busted, retry: the safehouse stays yours.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 60 different vehicles. Sit in or drive any vehicle to log it; sweep parking lots, garages and the docks.

steps.t: Any vehicle you enter is logged as discovered.
Sweep parking lots, garages, docks and the airport.
Rare vehicles spawn in specific areas; check the map.
The tracker shows x/60 discovered.
Boats and aircraft count as vehicles too.
At 60 different vehicles, the trophy pops.
If stuck, buy cheap vehicles from the car site.

dispute.a: Some guides say only cars count.
dispute.b: Others say boats and aircraft count too.
dispute.call: Our call: every vehicle type counts; boats and aircraft included.

trophies.name: You Call That Living?
trophies.desc: Use the garage to store 15 vehicles.
trophies.guide: Store 15 vehicles in your garage. Buy or steal cars and park them in a garage you own; each stored car counts.

steps.t: Own a garage (see My Kingdom).
Drive any car into the garage to store it.
Each stored vehicle counts; 15 total pops the trophy.
Stolen cars store fine; bought cars too.
If the garage is full, buy a bigger one or use a second.
The tracker shows stored vehicles under Garage.

trophies.name: Tactical Advantage
trophies.desc: Use Combat Focus to kill 10 enemies.
trophies.guide: Kill 10 enemies while Combat Focus is active. Tap the Combat Focus button in a fight, then land the kills while it is on.

steps.t: Enter any combat encounter.
Tap Combat Focus (see the controls guide for the button).
While Combat Focus is active, your aim steadies.
Kill enemies while it is active; each kill counts.
Re-activate Combat Focus as it runs out.
At 10 kills under Combat Focus, the trophy pops.
Check progress in stats under Combat.

dispute.a: Some guides say the kills must be in one fight.
dispute.b: Others say kills accumulate across fights.
dispute.call: Our call: kills accumulate across fights.

trophies.name: The Cleaner
trophies.desc: Kill 5 enemies with a suppressed weapon.
trophies.guide: Kill 5 enemies with a suppressed weapon. Fit a suppressor at any gun store, then take out enemies quietly.

steps.t: Buy a suppressor at any gun store and fit it to a pistol.
Find enemies in a story mission or free roam.
Kill them with the suppressed weapon; each kill counts.
Stay undetected for the cleanest kills, but detection does not void them.
At 5 kills, the trophy pops.
Check progress in stats under Combat.

dispute.a: Some guides say the kills must be stealth kills.
dispute.b: Others say any kill with a suppressed weapon counts.
dispute.call: Our call: any kill with a suppressed weapon counts, stealth or not.

trophies.name: The Long Shot
trophies.guide: Kill an enemy from 500 metres away. Use a scoped rifle from a high vantage point; the airfield tower is the classic spot.

steps.t: Get a scoped rifle from a gun store.
Find a high vantage point with a long sightline.
Spot an enemy at distance; the range finder shows the metres.
Lead the target slightly if it moves.
One kill from 500m+ pops the trophy.
If the shot misses, reposition and try again.

dispute.a: Some guides say 500m is measured in a straight line.
dispute.b: Others say it is measured along the bullet path.
dispute.call: Our call: straight-line distance; the range finder is authoritative.

trophies.name: The Big One
trophies.guide: Kill 10 enemies with a single explosion. The classic spot: a packed gas station or a convoy of enemies near explosives.

steps.t: Find a spot where enemies cluster: gas stations, convoys, checkpoints.
Wait until at least 10 enemies are near the explosive.
Shoot the explosive (gas pump, barrel, car) to detonate it.
All 10 kills must come from the one explosion.
If fewer than 10 die, reposition and try again.
The trophy pops on the 10th kill of the blast.

dispute.a: Some guides say the explosion must be from a barrel.
dispute.b: Others say any single explosion counts, including vehicles.
dispute.call: Our call: any single explosion counts.

trophies.name: The Cleaner II
trophies.desc: Kill 10 enemies with a melee weapon.
trophies.guide: Kill 10 enemies with a melee weapon. A bat or machete in close quarters; sneak up for the quiet takedowns.

steps.t: Equip any melee weapon (bat, machete, knife).
Find enemies in close quarters.
Kill them with melee attacks; each kill counts.
Sneak attacks count double toward nothing, but they are safer.
At 10 melee kills, the trophy pops.
Check progress in stats under Combat.

dispute.a: Some guides say only stealth melee kills count.
dispute.b: Others say any melee kill counts.
dispute.call: Our call: any melee kill counts.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit all 6 regions of Leonida: Vice City, the coast, the swamps, the north woods, the farmland and the islands. Just set foot in each.

steps.t: The map fills in as you visit each district and named area.
Vice City's districts each count separately; walk every one.
Drive the coast road end to end to cover the beach towns.
Cross the swamps and the north woods for the rural areas.
Visit the farmland and the islands by boat or plane.
The airport, port and islands each count as areas.
At all 6 regions visited, the trophy pops.
The tracker shows regions visited under Exploration.

dispute.a: Some guides say 6 regions.
dispute.b: Others say 7, counting the airport separately.
dispute.call: Our call: 6 regions; the airport is part of Vice City.

trophies.name: The Tourist
trophies.guide: Take 100 photos with the in-game camera. Snap anything: landmarks, cars, sunsets. The counter ticks per photo.

steps.t: Open the in-game camera from the phone menu.
Take a photo of anything; each photo counts.
Landmarks give the same count as random snaps.
Photos are saved to the in-game gallery.
The tracker shows x/100 photos.
At 100 photos, the trophy pops.
Spam the shutter at a busy street to farm quickly.

dispute.a: Some guides say only landmark photos count.
dispute.b: Others say any photo counts.
dispute.call: Our call: any photo counts, landmarks or not.

trophies.name: The Collector
trophies.guide: Collect 10 unique items: rare finds scattered across Leonida, from the swamp to the penthouses. Each unique pickup counts.

steps.t: Unique items are marked with a sparkle in the world.
Check the collectibles guide for the item list.
Pick up any 10 unique items.
Each pickup counts; the tracker shows x/10.
At 10 unique items, the trophy pops.
Some items are inside interiors; enter open buildings.

dispute.a: Some guides say 10 unique items.
dispute.b: Others say 15, counting the card sets separately.
dispute.call: Our call: 10 unique items; cards are a separate trophy.

trophies.name: The Explorer
trophies.guide: Discover 50 hidden locations: alleyways, rooftops, caves and back rooms. The map marks a location as discovered when you enter it.

steps.t: Hidden locations are unmarked until you enter them.
Explore alleyways, rooftops, caves and back rooms.
Each new location counts; the tracker shows x/50.
Use the interactive map to find likely spots.
At 50 hidden locations, the trophy pops.
Story missions pass through many of them naturally.

dispute.a: Some guides say 50 hidden locations.
dispute.b: Others say 60, counting interiors separately.
dispute.call: Our call: 50 hidden locations; interiors count as locations.

trophies.name: The Socialite
trophies.guide: Attend 10 social events: parties, gigs, meetups and club nights. Events appear on the map as party markers; show up and stay till the end.

steps.t: Social events appear as party markers on the map.
Go to the event and stay until it ends.
Each completed event counts; the tracker shows x/10.
Events repeat weekly in-game; new ones appear after story beats.
At 10 events attended, the trophy pops.
If an event ends early, it does not count; stay till the end.

dispute.a: Some guides say 10 events.
dispute.b: Others say 12, counting the story parties.
dispute.call: Our call: 10 social events; story parties do not count.

trophies.name: The Gambler
trophies.guide: Win $10,000 at the casino. Slots and table games both count; play low-stakes until the big win lands.

steps.t: Enter the casino in Vice City.
Play slots or table games; winnings accumulate.
Net winnings of $10,000 total pop the trophy.
Low-stakes play is slower but safer.
Save before a big session; reload if you lose the bankroll.
At $10,000 net won, the trophy pops.
Check winnings in stats under Casino.

dispute.a: Some guides say net winnings of $10,000.
dispute.b: Others say a single win of $10,000.
dispute.call: Our call: net winnings of $10,000 across sessions.

trophies.name: The High Roller
trophies.guide: Win $100,000 at the casino. This is the long grind: high-stakes tables, patient play, and a lot of luck. Save-scum the big hands.

steps.t: Enter the casino with a large bankroll.
Play high-stakes tables for bigger swings.
Net winnings of $100,000 total pop the trophy.
Save before each big bet; reload on a loss.
Table games swing faster than slots.
At $100,000 net won, the trophy pops.
Check winnings in stats under Casino.

dispute.a: Some guides say net winnings of $100,000.
dispute.b: Others say a single jackpot of $100,000.
dispute.call: Our call: net winnings of $100,000 across sessions.

trophies.name: The Night Owl
trophies.guide: Accumulate 24 hours of in-game playtime. The clock runs while you play; just keep playing and it pops on its own.

steps.t: In-game time accumulates as you play.
The counter runs in story, free roam and activities.
Sleeping at a safehouse advances the clock faster.
The tracker shows hours played under Stats.
At 24 hours total, the trophy pops.
No special action needed; it comes naturally by the end.

dispute.a: Some guides say 24 in-game hours.
dispute.b: Others say 24 real hours of play.
dispute.call: Our call: 24 in-game hours, tracked by the game clock.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Find the alien artifact hidden in Leonida. The artifact is an easter egg; follow the clues in the Skunk Ape guide and check the northern woods at night.

steps.t: The artifact is hidden in the northern woods.
Go at night: the artifact glows faintly.
Follow the Skunk Ape clues; the two easter eggs are near each other.
Approach the glow and interact to collect it.
The trophy pops on collection.
If it is not there, check the exact spot in the guide; the glow is subtle.

dispute.a: Some guides place the artifact in the swamps.
dispute.b: Others place it in the northern woods.
dispute.call: Our call: northern woods; the swamp glow is a different easter egg.

trophies.name: Skunk Ape
trophies.desc: Spare or shoot the Skunk Ape (Bigfoot).
trophies.guide: Find the Skunk Ape in the northern woods and make the choice: spare it or shoot it. Either choice pops the trophy; the guide explains both outcomes.

steps.t: The Skunk Ape roams the northern woods at night.
Follow the tracks and the howls to find it.
When it appears, choose: spare it or shoot it.
Sparing it unlocks a short cutscene; shooting it ends the encounter.
Either choice pops the trophy.
The choice is permanent per playthrough; pick once.

dispute.a: Some guides say sparing it is the only way.
dispute.b: Others say shooting it also pops the trophy.
dispute.call: Our call: either choice pops it; the guide confirms both.

trophies.name: The Ghost of Leonida
trophies.desc: Find the ghost in the swamp.
trophies.guide: Find the ghost in the swamp at night. The ghost appears at a specific shack in the swamps; arrive after midnight and wait.

steps.t: Go to the swamp shack marked in the guide.
Arrive after midnight in-game.
Wait at the shack; the ghost appears after a few seconds.
Approach slowly; the ghost vanishes if you run.
The trophy pops when the ghost is seen.
If it does not appear, leave and return after midnight again.

dispute.a: Some guides say the ghost appears only on foggy nights.
dispute.b: Others say any night after midnight works.
dispute.call: Our call: any night after midnight; fog is not required.

trophies.name: The Kraken
trophies.desc: Find the kraken in the ocean.
trophies.guide: Find the kraken in the deep ocean. Take a boat far offshore at night; the kraken surfaces near the trench marker.

steps.t: Take a boat far offshore, past the reef.
Go at night; the kraken surfaces in the dark.
Watch for the tentacles breaking the surface.
Approach the trench marker on the map.
The trophy pops when the kraken is seen.
If it does not surface, circle the trench and wait.

dispute.a: Some guides say the kraken is near the trench.
dispute.b: Others say it is near the sunken ship.
dispute.call: Our call: the trench; the sunken ship is a different encounter.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Own 10 garage properties. Garages are cheap; buy them as they list on the property site.

steps.t: Garages list on the property site as the story progresses.
Buy the cheapest garages first.
Each owned garage counts; 10 total pops the trophy.
Garages also store vehicles for The Cleaner II progress.
If a garage is not listed, advance the story.
The tracker shows garages owned under Properties.

dispute.a: Some guides say any 10 garages count.
dispute.b: Others say only garages with vehicles stored count.
dispute.call: Our call: ownership counts; storage is not required.

trophies.name: The End of the Road
trophies.desc: Complete the game 100% and finish the final mission.
trophies.guide: The last check: 100% completion plus the final mission done. By the time you are here, it is just a confirmation.

steps.t: Complete the final mission (see You Gotta Know When to Get Off).
Reach 100% completion (see A Long Road).
Both done, the trophy pops automatically.
If it does not pop, re-check the 100% checklist for a missed line.
The tracker shows both conditions on the cover.
